investigators.name: Nora Mercer
investigators.description: A disciplined interviewer who notices the emotional cost of a lie.
investigators.strength: Rapport — Nora can press a reluctant witness without automatically turning them hostile.

investigators.name: Isaac Ward
investigators.description: A patient reconstructionist who reads machinery, traces, and damaged spaces.
investigators.strength: Reconstruction — Isaac can establish a physical sequence from incomplete scene evidence.
